panels.description: A wind-scoured Keel pump station built into a mineral-stained legacy copper and polymetallic hard-rock mine wall. Exposed pipes, patched conduit, dust, worn safety placards, and a dry collection channel show a laboring city whose infrastructure has been repeatedly repaired. Alex Phantum is a small figure crouched beside an open pump housing at lower-right; leave the upper-left sky and dark mine-wall area clear for a caption, with no lettering over Alex.

Alex Phantum kneels beside the open pump, one sleeve rolled higher, his weathered cross-body tool bag hanging at his hip. He presses two fingers against the casing to read its vibration while holding a hand tool ready in the other hand. Leave the top third and left edge clear for his speech balloon; keep his face and hands unobstructed.

Close insert of the damaged pump coupling and a crooked pressure gauge. Alex's grease-marked thumb braces the coupling from the lower edge as a thin thread of mineral-stained water leaks past the seal. Leave the upper third open for the sound effect; keep the gauge and coupling visually clear, with no readable text inside the image.

Alex Phantum tightens an improvised replacement fitting from his tool bag. His posture is guarded and concentrated; the exposed machinery fills the foreground while the empty collection channel recedes behind him. Leave the top-left open for his speech balloon and keep the tool hand visible.

The repaired pump jolts into operation, sending a forceful stream into the collection channel. Alex Phantum is visibly half-risen from the repair, with knees still bent, torso lifted, one hand still near the pump housing, and his attention divided between the water stream and Foreman-7; his expression is startled but satisfied. Foreman-7 turns toward him in the background: a waist-high, dust-coated mine-supervisor automaton with a broad rectangular gray-polymer and rusted-steel body, two inspection arms, a vertical amber status bar, a scratched transparent camera hood, a dangling cable bundle, and a red-and-white maintenance placard bearing Alpha's interrupted-line mark. Reserve the upper-right exclusively for Foreman-7's balloon and the lower-left mechanical space for the large sound effect; keep the two lettering areas separate and do not cover Alex's face, the water stream, or Foreman-7's status bar.

items.text: KEEL — BEFORE THE RECORD CATCHES UP.

items.speaker: FOREMAN-7
items.text: Unauthorized repair detected. Remain at the worksite.
